title: Replacement Shipping on Severe Tailwise Pharmacy Dispensing Errors
content:
*Pharmacy fulfilment, service recovery.*

The shipping portion of a Tailwise Pharmacy dispensing-error refund depends on the claim and on how the claimed fill — the most recent dispensed fill of the prescription — was ordered, as the fill's channel on the pharmacy ledger shows it. A severe claim is a claim of wrong medication or wrong strength.

## Rule

- Where the claim is severe and the claimed fill was a one-time order, the shipping portion is the shipping fee charged on the fill plus the class's standard pharmacy shipping fee for one shipment, so that the replacement order ships at no cost to the customer.
- Where the claim is severe and the claimed fill shipped through Autoship, the shipping portion is the class's standard pharmacy shipping fee for one shipment alone.
- Any other claim takes the shipping fee charged on the fill.

The class's standard pharmacy shipping fee is the figure the shipping schedule sets for the prescription's class.

## Table

| Claim | Claimed fill ordered as | Shipping portion of the refund |
|---|---|---|
| Wrong medication or wrong strength | one-time order | shipping fee charged on the fill plus one standard pharmacy shipping fee of the class |
| Wrong medication or wrong strength | Autoship | one standard pharmacy shipping fee of the class |
| Wrong quantity or wrong label | either | shipping fee charged on the fill |

## Illustrations (hypothetical; class standard fee taken as $4.95)

- Wrong strength, one-time order, shipping fee charged $0.00 (the free-shipping threshold was met): shipping portion $4.95.
- Wrong medication, one-time order, shipping fee charged $4.95: shipping portion $9.90.
- Wrong medication, Autoship fill, no pharmacy shipping fee on the fill: shipping portion $4.95.
- Wrong label, one-time order, shipping fee charged $4.95: shipping portion $4.95.
